content.title: About
content.content: Strawberry juice 100 % is a completely natural beverage made from ripe fresh strawberries without added sugar, preservatives or flavorings. It has a bright aroma, sweet‑tart taste and retains most of the vitamins and antioxidants characteristic of fresh berries.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Strawberries are one of the most popular berry flavors worldwide, and their aroma is widely used in cuisine and perfumery.
Strawberry juice retains a large portion of vitamin C, which is lost during heat processing.
Strawberry juice is often used in baby foods because of its mild taste and high nutritional value.
In Russia, strawberry juice is traditionally served in the summer, but frozen berries make it available year‑round.
Strawberry juice can serve as a base for cocktails, smoothies and dessert sauces.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and anthocyanins in strawberry juice help combat free radicals and reduce oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports heart health
items.content: Potassium in the juice contributes to normal blood pressure, and polyphenols may improve vascular function.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: A small amount of soluble fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low‑calorie beverage
items.content: Without added sugar, strawberry juice is relatively low in calories, making it a good choice for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Strawberry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to strawberries, ranging from skin rashes to gastrointestinal symptoms.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Even without added sugar, the natural sugars in the juice can be significant for people monitoring blood glucose.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature of the juice may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcer disease.

items.title: Pasteurization
items.content: Heat treatment can degrade some vitamins; choose juice that undergoes minimal processing.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Strawberry juice can be enjoyed chilled as a refreshing drink, used in smoothies, cocktails, dessert sauces, or as a base for fruit punches. It can also be diluted with water or sweetened with honey for a milder flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in a sealed container. After opening, consume within 3‑5 days. Frozen juice retains quality for up to 6 months.
